profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dscout
profile.summary:
As a frontend-focused software engineer, I plan, build, and iterate on new features for a product team, using React and TypeScript. I consistently collaborate with design and product to deliver impactful features always with the end user in mind.

My background in psychology helps me with understanding user behavior and needs, as well as with communicating effectively with team members across disciplines. I also have a strong quality mindset, having worked as a QA Analyst/Engineer for over 3 years before switching into software development. I'm passionate about creating user-friendly and accessible web applications that solve real problems and make a difference.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I write the bugs now!

or... I try to squash them earlier.

I also:
• Plan, build, and iterate on new features for a product team, primarily using React, TypeScript and GraphQL (and dabbling in Elixir)
• Collaborate with design and product to deliver impactful features with the end user in mind

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
I squashed some more bugs and...
• Reviewed requirements & ensured quality of features before merging into production
• Grew our automated test suite using RSpec & Capybara
• Collaborated with product managers, designers, & developers on team to think through the technical implementation of new features as well as the end-to-end user experience

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
I squashed bugs and also...
• Tested new features for iOS, Android and web to ensure quality before release 
• Discovered and helped eliminate bugs through testing with functional team
• Worked collaboratively alongside designers and developers to assist with new feature development

positions.title: Compliance Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted with compliance filings for local, state, and federal government 
• Organized and submitted applications for grants  for new development
• Coordinated with state and federal government for bottle and can label approval

positions.title: Psychometrician
positions.description:
Psychometrician at the Knight Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) at Washington University School of Medicine

• Administered neuropsychological tests to research participants as part of an ongoing longitudinal study on aging and dementias
• Aided in design of research materials for new ADRCs around the world 
• Analyzed datasets from ADRCs across the country to find patterns in the data
• Established rapport with older adult populations, some with memory impairments, in order to facilitate testing process
